description.value: Established in 1979 and family-owned since 1989, the Cat and Fiddle is a Port Coquitlam institution that has been voted Best Pub in BC by the Province and Best Neighbourhood Pub by Tricity News. With five patios and nearly 400 seats, it is a large, lively community hub known for its traditional pub fare and long-running Wednesday wing nights. Touring cyclists riding through the Tri-Cities area will find a well-known, welcoming stop with plenty of seating.
